recognize_zh: 脊椎矢狀切面 MRI：A 為胸椎（脂肪抑制序列），椎體與後方附件可見散在不均勻的異常訊號；B 為腰薦椎顯影後脂肪抑制 T1，多個椎體與棘突內佈滿斑駁、多發的顯影病灶（variegated pattern）；廣泛多發的骨髓浸潤病灶符合多發性骨髓瘤的 MRI 表現。
features: Panel A: sagittal fat-suppressed (STIR/T2-weighted type) MRI of the thoracic spine with patchy heterogeneous signal in vertebral bodies and posterior elements
Panel B: sagittal contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed T1-weighted MRI of the lumbosacral spine
Multiple mottled, heterogeneously enhancing focal lesions throughout the lumbar vertebral bodies and spinous processes ('variegated' or salt-and-pepper pattern)
Vertebral body heights largely preserved; no obvious epidural mass or cord compression on these images
describe_en: Sagittal MRI of the spine demonstrates multifocal marrow abnormalities. The thoracic spine (A, fat-suppressed fluid-sensitive sequence) shows patchy heterogeneous signal within vertebral bodies and posterior elements, and the contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed T1-weighted image of the lumbosacral spine (B) shows numerous mottled, enhancing focal lesions throughout the vertebral bodies and spinous processes with sparing of the intervertebral discs. No definite vertebral collapse or epidural extension is seen on these images. The multifocal marrow infiltration is compatible with multiple myeloma; more than one focal lesion of at least 5 mm on MRI is a myeloma-defining event when correlated with a clonal plasma cell disorder.

ddx.vs: Metastases tend to be fewer, larger and often involve pedicles with a known primary, whereas myeloma shows diffuse or innumerable small variegated lesions with a monoclonal protein; biopsy separates them.
Lymphoma and leukemia usually produce diffuse homogeneous marrow replacement and require marrow biopsy with immunophenotyping for distinction.
Red marrow reconversion (e.g., anemia, G-CSF) is diffuse and symmetric with mild enhancement and signal higher than disc on T1, lacking discrete focal lesions.
Infection centers on the intervertebral disc with endplate destruction and paraspinal collections, whereas the discs here are spared.
